meta.name: mem-search
meta.description: This skill should be used when the user asks to "search memory", "what do you remember about X", "check claude-mem", "mem search", "find past observations", "what did we do last session", or wants prior-session context about a project, decision, file, or task. Searches the user's Claude-Mem (cmem.ai) memory.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 调出过往对话里与目标相关的记录
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常开多个会话，想搜回过往聊过的人、事或结论，免去重复询问。
copy.tagline_en: Pull up relevant records from your past conversations.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often run many sessions and want to recall people, tasks, or conclusions from past chats.

howto.what: 用户要求“搜索记忆”时，Claude 会查询 cmem.ai 上跨会话的历史观察记录，只提炼相关要点后用平实中文回答，不直接丢出原始查询结果。
howto.when: 当用户说“search memory”“mem search”等，或想了解某个项目、决定、文件、任务的过往会话背景时触发。

say.text: 搜索记忆：我们上次聊到哪了？
say.note: 会查近期会话观察并简要回答。

say.text: 查一下 claude-mem，我对登录模块有过什么结论？
say.note: 返回该模块的相关历史观察。

say.text: 找过去关于数据库迁移的观察记录。
say.note: 中文总结命中内容并说明时间。

howto.what_en: When the user asks to search memory, Claude queries the user's cross-session observations on cmem.ai via a bundled script, then summarizes only the relevant points in plain language instead of dumping raw results.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user says things like 'search memory' or 'mem search', or asks for prior-session context about a project, decision, file, or task.

say_en.text: Search memory: where did we leave off last time?
say_en.note: Looks up recent-session observations and replies briefly.

say_en.text: Check claude-mem: what did I conclude about the login module?
say_en.note: Returns relevant past observations for that module.

say_en.text: Find past observations about the database migration.
say_en.note: Summarizes hits in plain language and mentions when.
